semantic_freeze.tie_break: toward 5.0 when adjacent buckets are genuinely supportable

positive_contract.minimum_buy: A positive issuer-level material anchor plus sufficiently current or economically independent corroboration supports 6.0.
positive_contract.stronger_buy: Distinct current support that materially strengthens corroboration, persistence, quality, visibility, or valuation beyond minimum direction can support 6.5.
positive_contract.adjacent_ambiguity: Use 6.0 when a material unresolved causal, reversibility, persistence, or critical-validation limit makes both 6.0 and 6.5 genuinely supportable.
positive_contract.missing_domain: Missing one domain is not a universal 6.5 cap.
positive_contract.expectations: Elevated expectations are weighed by established economic effect and do not mechanically set the bucket.

negative_contract.symmetry: Apply the exact ordinal logic to minimum and stronger SELL support.
negative_contract.adjacent_ambiguity: Use SELL 6.0 rather than 6.5 when a material unresolved limit makes both adjacent negative buckets genuinely supportable.

fic_fin_01.target_change_reason: Distinct current operating improvement, reported cash conversion, and net-cash resilience materially exceed minimum BUY support; the retained Unknowns and cautions do not make the adjacent buckets genuinely ambiguous.
